# authwise_guard_node_groups (Data Source)

A Guard node group: a named set of a network's nodes that grants and serving name as one. A group may be granted what its members reach (`authwise_guard_node_group_grants`), be granted to a node or another group (members are reached as one), and serve a resource (`authwise_guard_resource_node_groups`: every member serves it). Members are added by hand (`authwise_guard_node_group_members`) or by the credential a node joins with: an `authwise_guard_enrollment_key` or `authwise_guard_cluster_trust_rule` that names the group adds each node it enrolls, so a pod that joins is reachable and served at once. A group named by an unrevoked enrollment key or a cluster trust rule is not deleted (`NODE_GROUP_IN_USE`): Terraform's dependency order removes those first when they reference this resource. Deleting a group removes its memberships, grants and serving; the nodes stay. This data source lists every one under a parent.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tenant_id` (String) The kit tenant's id (`t-…`) the Guard row belongs to. Guard has no tenant of its own since the tenant collapse (tf#65). The provider's `tenant_id` is not used.

### Optional

- `network_id` (String) Parent identifier `network_id`; overrides the provider default.

### Read-Only

- `guard_node_groups` (Attributes List) Every node_group under the parent, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--guard_node_groups))

<a id="nestedatt--guard_node_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `guard_node_groups`
